title: Western University Civil and Environmental Engineering Programs in Canada | Undergraduate and Graduate Study Opportunities
summary: If you are interested in studying civil engineering, environmental engineering, structural engineering, infrastructure, water resources, smart cities, or sustainable development in Canada , the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Western University offers a broad range of undergraduate and graduate study options. Located in London, Ontario, Canada , Western University s Civil and Environmental Engineering department combines engineering education with research, industry connections, sustainability, emerging technologies, and real-world project experience. The department offers undergraduate pathways as well as graduate programs leading to Master of Engineering (MEng), Master of Engineering Science (MESc), and PhD degrees. ( Western Engineering ) About Civil and Environmental Engineering at Western University The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering is part of the Faculty of Engineering at Western University and provides education and research opportunities across several areas of civil and environmental engineering. The department highlights its strong links with industry and affiliated research centres, including the Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel Laboratory, Geotechnical Research Centre, Institute for Catastrophic Loss Reduction, Centre for Environment and Sustainability, and Wind Engineering, Energy and Environment Research Institute. Western s undergraduate Civil Engineering program is accredited through the Canadian Engineering Accreditation Board (CEAB) , with the curriculum designed around the graduate attributes expected of accredited engineering programs in Canada. \ Undergraduate Civil Engineering at Western University Students entering Western Engineering initially complete a Common First Year before moving into their selected engineering discipline. After completing the common first year, students can enter Civil Engineering and later select from different options and concurrent pathways. The department s undergraduate options include: Structural Engineering Environmental Engineering International Development with Structural Engineering International Development with Environmental Engineering Civil Engineering and Business Civil Engineering and Law Civil Engineering and Artificial Intelligence Systems Engineering, Smart Cities and Structural Engineering Civil Engineering and Artificial Intelligence Systems Engineering, Smart Cities and Environmental Engineering The available pathways allow students to combine traditional civil engineering education with areas such as business, law, international development, artificial intelligence, and smart-city technologies. Structural Engineering The Structural Engineering option provides students with training in areas related to the analysis and design of structures and infrastructure. Courses and areas of study include: Structural theory and design Reinforced and prestressed concrete design Steel design Structural dynamics Finite element design Tall buildings Soil mechanics Sustainable development Engineering ethics Engineering law This pathway is particularly relevant for students interested in structural and infrastructure engineering and the design of safe and resilient structures. Environmental Engineering Western s Environmental Engineering option focuses on addressing environmental challenges and developing solutions that support a more sustainable future. Environmental engineers combine knowledge from areas including mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, and geology to address problems such as climate change, water management, environmental contamination, and sustainable infrastructure. Students can explore areas including: Climate change adaptation Green infrastructure Drinking water services Water resources management Contaminated-site cleanup Municipal infrastructure Environmental policy Sustainable development Graduates can pursue careers in consulting, industry, government, non-governmental organisations, and research. ( Western Engineering ) Civil Engineering and International Development Western also provides Civil Engineering pathways that combine engineering education with International Development . The International Development option exposes students to the social, environmental, political, and economic factors involved in creating safer and more sustainable communities in Canada and developing regions. A major component is the Summer Community Development Placement and Design Project , through which students can gain practical experience working in developing countries or communities in need in Canada. Western notes that students have undertaken placements in countries including Madagascar, The Gambia, Ghana, China and India . This pathway can be particularly attractive to students who want to combine engineering with international development and community-focused work. Civil Engineering and Artificial Intelligence: Smart Cities Western also offers a five-year concurrent pathway combining Civil Engineering with Artificial Intelligence Systems Engineering (AISE) and Smart Cities. The programme is designed to equip students with modern AI tools and engineering knowledge that can be applied to challenges in the built environment. Students receive training in areas such as AI fundamentals, deep learning, algorithms, data structures, and the application of AI to engineering problems. Two highlighted pathways combine AISE and Smart Cities with: Structural Engineering Environmental Engineering The structural pathway explores applications such as design optimisation, structural health monitoring, structural safety, design, and analysis. The environmental pathway focuses on interdisciplinary solutions related to sustainable development, including sustainable cities, clean energy, clean water and sanitation, responsible consumption, and infrastructure. ( Western Engineering ) Practical Learning and Capstone Projects Western s Civil and Environmental Engineering programme places emphasis on applying engineering knowledge to practical problems. The undergraduate programme includes a fourth-year capstone design experience in which students work on real-world engineering projects. The department states that these projects can be identified by the City of London and supported by faculty members and external consulting engineers. The capstone experience requires students to apply technical knowledge while considering factors such as: Economic considerations Health and safety Environmental impacts Social considerations Engineering design Technical analysis Professional communication Students also develop their ability to communicate engineering solutions through reports, drawings, and presentations. Graduate Programs in Civil and Environmental Engineering Western University offers three major graduate degree pathways in Civil and Environmental Engineering: 1. Master of Engineering (MEng) The MEng is a professional graduate degree designed for practicing engineers seeking career advancement as well as graduates who want to strengthen their technical knowledge. The programme can be completed as either a course-based or project-based degree. The full-time programme is structured over three terms, or approximately 12 months . A part-time option is also available. The MEng offers specialisations in: Environmental and Water Resources Engineering Structural and Infrastructural Engineering Smart Cities The Smart Cities specialisation is offered for the Summer term intake. Students undertaking the course-based MEng complete 10 courses , while the project-based option consists of 8 courses plus an MEng project. 2. Master of Engineering Science (MESc) The MESc is a thesis-based research degree designed for students interested in conducting independent and innovative research in Civil and Environmental Engineering. The programme takes approximately two years or six terms and requires a four-year bachelor s degree in engineering from an accredited university or a similar programme that may be considered. The published minimum admission average is 78% (A- North Research students work under the supervision of faculty members and can conduct fundamental, computational, or applied research depending on their area of interest. 3. Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) The PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering is a research-intensive programme designed for students seeking advanced research training. The programme is listed as approximately four years or 12 terms . Applicants normally require a master s degree in engineering from an accredited university or a similar qualification that may be considered, with a published minimum average of 78% . The PhD is thesis-based and provides opportunities for advanced research under faculty supervision. Graduate Research Areas Western s Civil and Environmental Engineering research activities cover several major areas. These include: Environmental and Water Resources Research and graduate coursework address issues involving water systems, environmental engineering, climate hazards, groundwater, watershed modelling, and related challenges. Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering This area focuses on soils, foundations, geotechnical systems, and environmental challenges associated with the ground and subsurface environment. Structural and Infrastructural Engineering Research and coursework cover structures, infrastructure, structural health monitoring, design, materials, and related engineering challenges. Wind Engineering and Environmental Fluid Mechanics Western has significant research activity in wind engineering and environmental fluid mechanics, supported by specialised facilities and research institutes. Smart Cities Smart Cities is another area connected to the department s growing focus on technology, data, AI, infrastructure, and sustainable urban development. Graduate Admission Requirements For the graduate programmes, the published requirements differ according to the degree. Programme Typical Duration Minimum Academic Requirement Format MEng 1 year / 3 terms 4-year engineering bachelor s degree; minimum 70% Course-based or project-based MESc 2 years / 6 terms 4-year engineering bachelor s degree; minimum 78% Thesis-based PhD 4 years / 12 terms Master s degree in engineering; minimum 78% Thesis-based A similar academic programme may be considered where applicable. Applicants should always verify the current admission requirements before submitting an application because programme requirements and application procedures can change. English Language Requirements International applicants whose first language is not English, or who do not meet Western s specified prior-English-education exemption, may need to demonstrate English-language proficiency. The graduate programme information lists the following accepted examinations and minimum scores: IELTS Academic: 6.5 overall, with no individual section below 6 Duolingo English Test: 115 CAEL: 60 Western English Language Centre: successful completion of the High-Advanced level Fanshawe College ESL: graduation from Level 10 EAP with a minimum of 80% in all components Western also lists TOEFL requirements, with the scoring requirement depending on when the test was taken. Applicants should check the current official graduate admissions information before applying. = Funding Opportunities for Graduate Students Funding availability depends on the graduate programme. Western states that funding is available for admissible research students in the MESc and PhD programmes , while funding is not provided for MEng students through the programme. Students interested in research-based graduate study should therefore investigate available funding and scholarship opportunities as part of the application process. Career Opportunities A Civil and Environmental Engineering education can lead to careers across a wide range of sectors. Western notes that graduates can pursue opportunities in areas including: Engineering consulting Municipal government Provincial government Federal government Resource companies Environmental consulting Water resources Infrastructure Construction Research Sustainability Technology International development The department also highlights that its graduates can pursue leadership and entrepreneurship opportunities across multiple professions. Environmental Engineering graduates, for example, have gone on to work in consulting, government, research and industry, with alumni working at organisations including AECOM, Dillon Consulting, Google, Golder Associates and other companies. Who Should Consider Studying Civil and Environmental Engineering at Western? Western s programmes may be particularly suitable for students and graduates interested in: Civil engineering Structural engineering Environmental engineering Water resources Infrastructure Sustainable development Climate resilience Geotechnical engineering Wind engineering Smart cities Artificial intelligence in engineering International development Engineering research Students interested in combining engineering with another discipline can also explore Western s concurrent and dual-degree options. How to Apply Prospective students should use Western University s official admissions channels to determine the appropriate application route for their chosen programme. For undergraduate applicants, the Civil and Environmental Engineering department directs prospective students to Western Engineering s undergraduate admissions and future-student resources. For graduate applicants, the appropriate route depends on whether the applicant is applying for the MEng, MESc or PhD . Official Civil and Environmental Engineering Department: Western University Civil and Environmental Engineering Graduate programme information: Western University Civil and Environmental Engieering Graduate Programs Applicants should carefully review the programme-specific admission requirements, required documents, English-language requirements and application deadlines before submitting an application. Important Information About Deadlines The graduate admissions page provides different application deadlines depending on the intended intake and whether the applicant is domestic or international. However, the published page currently contains a Fall international deadline labelled February 10, 2025 , which is already past and should not be presented as a current 2026/2027 deadline. Therefore, applicants should confirm the current deadline directly with Western University before applying , particularly for upcoming intakes. Conclusion The Civil and Environmental Engineering programmes at Western University provide students with opportunities to develop engineering knowledge while exploring major challenges involving infrastructure, sustainability, climate change, water resources, structural systems, technology, and urban development. At undergraduate level, students can choose from structural and environmental engineering pathways and can combine civil engineering with international development, business, law, artificial intelligence, and Smart Cities. At graduate level, Western offers MEng, MESc and PhD programmes , allowing students to choose between professional training and research-focused study. Research opportunities span environmental and water resources, geotechnical and geoenvironmental engineering, structural and infrastructure engineering, wind engineering and environmental fluid mechanics, and Smart Cities. For students seeking an engineering education connected to real-world infrastructure, environmental sustainability, emerging technology and research, Western University s Civil and Environmental Engineering department is an option worth exploring. title: Schneider Electric 2027 Graduate Programme in Nigeria | 24-Month Graduate Career Opportunity
summary: The Schneider Electric 2027 Graduate Programme in Nigeria is an opportunity for recent Nigerian graduates to begin their professional careers with a global leader in energy management and industrial automation. The programme offers a structured 24-month learning and development experience designed to help graduates build technical, commercial, and leadership capabilities while contributing to real business projects. Based in Lagos, Nigeria , the graduate programme provides participants with practical workplace experience, rotational assignments, mentorship, exposure to industry-leading technologies, and opportunities to collaborate with diverse teams. Applications are currently open, and interested candidates are encouraged to apply online while the position remains available. About the Schneider Electric 2027 Graduate Programme The Schneider Electric Graduate Programme is designed to support talented graduates as they transition from university into the professional workplace. As part of the 2027 Graduate Programme , successful candidates will undertake a structured 24-month development journey . During the programme, graduates will have opportunities to work on real projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, and gain exposure to technologies and solutions shaping the future of energy, automation, electrification, and digital transformation. The programme is particularly suited to graduates who are ambitious, adaptable, analytical, and interested in building careers at the intersection of technology and sustainability. Participants will be based in Lagos, Nigeria , and are expected to commit to completing the full 24-month programme. What Graduates Will Do Successful participants will take part in rotational assignments and practical learning experiences designed to accelerate their professional development. Throughout the programme, graduates will: Work on real business projects that deliver meaningful impact for customers and the organisation. Gain exposure to industry-leading technologies, products, and solutions. Collaborate with diverse teams and cross-functional stakeholders. Develop practical experience in a fast-paced and innovative working environment. Build technical, commercial, and leadership capabilities. Participate in structured learning and development activities. Receive mentorship and coaching from experienced professionals and leaders. Develop an understanding of how sustainability, digital transformation, automation, and electrification are shaping modern industries. Areas of Study Eligible for the Programme Applicants must hold a BEng or BSc degree in one of the following disciplines: Electrical and Electronics Engineering Electrical and Computer Engineering Statistics and Mathematics Computer Science Human Resources Psychology Applicants should ensure that their academic background corresponds to one of the eligible disciplines before submitting an application. Eligibility Requirements To be considered for the Schneider Electric 2027 Graduate Programme, applicants must meet the following requirements: Academic Qualification Applicants must: Hold a BEng or BSc degree in one of the eligible disciplines. Have obtained a minimum of Second Class Upper Division or an equivalent CGPA. Have graduated from an accredited university. Graduation Requirement The programme is targeted at recent graduates. Applicants must either: Be part of the Class of 2026 , or Be expected to graduate within the next six months in 2026. NYSC Requirement Applicants must also meet the programme s National Youth Service Corps requirement. Candidates must: Have completed their NYSC camp within the previous three months , or Be expected to complete NYSC camp within the next six months in 2026. Work Authorization Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Nigeria . Location Requirement Successful candidates must be willing and able to be based in Lagos, Nigeria , for the duration of the graduate programme. Programme Commitment Applicants must be: Available to commence the programme in February 2027 . Willing to commit to the full 24-month Graduate Programme . Prepared to participate fully in the programme s learning, rotational, and professional development activities. Participation in the Schneider Electric Graduate Programme does not guarantee permanent employment with the company after the programme is completed. Skills and Qualities Schneider Electric Is Looking For Beyond academic qualifications, Schneider Electric is looking for graduates who demonstrate strong potential and a willingness to learn and grow. Successful candidates are expected to have: Strong Learning Mindset Applicants should demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn new concepts, technologies, and approaches. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills The ability to analyse information, identify challenges, and develop practical solutions is important for graduates working across different projects and functions. Communication and Interpersonal Skills Candidates should be able to communicate effectively and build positive working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders. Collaboration The programme involves working with diverse teams and functions. Applicants should therefore be comfortable collaborating with people from different backgrounds and areas of expertise. Adaptability Graduates will work in a dynamic environment and may encounter new responsibilities, technologies, and challenges. Adaptability and initiative are therefore important. Interest in Sustainability and Technology Schneider Electric is particularly interested in candidates who have a strong interest in areas such as: Sustainability Digital transformation Emerging technologies Automation Electrification Energy management What the Schneider Electric Graduate Programme Offers The programme is structured to give graduates more than their first professional experience. It is designed to help participants develop capabilities that can support their long-term careers. Meaningful Work From Day One Participants will contribute to projects that help customers become more efficient, resilient, and sustainable. Structured Professional Development The 24-month programme provides a structured approach to learning and professional development, allowing graduates to progressively build their capabilities. Mentorship and Coaching Participants will have opportunities to learn from experienced leaders and subject-matter experts who can provide guidance throughout the programme. Global Exposure Joining Schneider Electric gives graduates exposure to a global industrial technology company operating across numerous countries and markets. This can provide insight into international practices and approaches to business and technology. Career Development The programme enables participants to develop technical knowledge, professional experience, workplace skills, and networks that can support future career opportunities. Purpose-Driven Experience Schneider Electric positions sustainability at the centre of its work. Graduates will have the opportunity to contribute to solutions connected to efficiency, resilience, electrification, automation, and digitalisation. Schneider Electric s IMPACT Values Schneider Electric describes its workplace culture through its IMPACT values , which represent: Inclusion Mastery Purpose Action Curiosity Teamwork The company encourages employees to contribute to its sustainability ambitions and become what it describes as IMPACT Makers — people who turn sustainability ambitions into practical action. For graduate applicants, this means that technical knowledge is only one part of what Schneider Electric is looking for. Candidates should also demonstrate curiosity, collaboration, initiative, and a willingness to contribute to meaningful work. About Schneider Electric Schneider Electric is a global industrial technology company working across areas including energy management, electrification, automation, and digitalisation. The company states that it has: €40 billion in global revenue 150,000+ employees Operations in 100+ countries +9% organic growth Through its technologies and solutions, Schneider Electric works with customers and organisations seeking to improve efficiency, resilience, sustainability, and digital transformation. Programme Location The Schneider Electric 2027 Graduate Programme will be based in: Lagos, Nigeria The programme is listed as a hybrid opportunity, but successful candidates must be willing and able to be based in Lagos for the duration of the programme. Programme Duration The Graduate Programme is structured to run for: 24 months Participants are expected to commit to the complete programme. Expected Start Date Successful applicants are expected to commence the programme in: February 2027 How to Apply for the Schneider Electric 2027 Graduate Programme Interested and eligible graduates must submit an online application through Schneider Electric s official recruitment platform. Applicants should carefully review the requirements before applying and ensure that the information provided in their application accurately reflects their academic qualifications, graduation status, NYSC status, and work authorization. Application: Apply for the Schneider Electric 2027 Graduate Programme Schneider Electric states that an online application must be submitted for candidates to be considered for the position. Application Deadline There is no fixed application deadline stated for this opportunity. The position is listed as being open until filled , meaning interested candidates should not wait until the programme s expected start date before applying. Applicants are encouraged to submit their applications as early as possible while the vacancy remains available. Important Information for Applicants Before applying, candidates should carefully confirm that they: Have a BEng or BSc degree in one of the specified disciplines. Have achieved at least a Second Class Upper Division or equivalent CGPA. Are part of the Class of 2026 or meet the stated graduation timeline. Meet the NYSC camp requirement. Are legally authorized to work in Nigeria. Are willing to be based in Lagos. Can commence the programme in February 2027. Can commit to the complete 24-month programme. Applicants should also understand that successfully completing the Graduate Programme does not automatically result in a permanent employment position. Why Graduates Should Consider the Programme For graduates seeking to move from university into a structured professional environment, the Schneider Electric Graduate Programme provides an opportunity to combine practical workplace experience with formal development. Rather than being limited to classroom-based learning, participants are expected to contribute to real projects, work with experienced professionals, gain exposure to global business practices, and develop skills across technical, commercial, and leadership areas. The programme may therefore be particularly relevant to graduates interested in building careers connected to engineering, technology, business functions, sustainability, digital transformation, and energy. Conclusion The Schneider Electric 2027 Graduate Programme in Nigeria provides eligible Class of 2026 graduates and qualifying upcoming graduates with an opportunity to begin their careers through a structured 24-month professional development programme. With opportunities for practical project experience, rotational assignments, mentorship, global exposure, and skills development, the programme is designed to help graduates develop the capabilities required for the changing world of energy, technology, automation, and sustainability. Eligible graduates who meet the academic, NYSC, work authorization, location, and programme commitment requirements should consider submitting their applications early, as the position will remain available only until it is filled. title: WSAI Fellowships 2026 at IIT Madras: Postdoctoral and Post-Baccalaureate Research Opportunities in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
summary: The Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (WSAI) at IIT Madras is offering a range of fellowship opportunities for talented researchers, graduates, postgraduates, and women interested in advancing their careers in Data Science (DS) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) . The WSAI fellowship programmes provide an opportunity to work in a highly interdisciplinary research environment, collaborate with leading experts, access advanced computing infrastructure, develop independent research interests, publish academic research, and engage with scientists and researchers from around the world. The fellowship opportunities currently featured by WSAI include Post Doctoral Fellowships, Post Bacc Fellowships, and the Women Post Bacc Fellowship Program . Each programme targets a different stage of an applicant s academic or research career, making the opportunities relevant to both experienced researchers and promising early-career graduates. WSAI was founded in 2024 with the goal of bringing together faculty members with expertise across Data Science and Artificial Intelligence to work on impactful problems that have direct relevance to society. Through its fellowship programmes, the School seeks to develop scientific talent while creating an environment where fellows can pursue meaningful research and build long-term academic and professional careers. Opportunity Category: Fellowship Host Institution: Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (WSAI), IIT Madras, India Fields: Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and allied application domains Location: IIT Madras, India Application Deadline: No specific deadline is stated on the provided WSAI fellowship information. Applicants should therefore consult the official fellowship application pages for the current application status and any deadline that may apply. About the Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence The Wadhwani School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (WSAI) is an academic and research school at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) . Founded in 2024, the School brings together faculty members with expertise in different areas of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. Its work is focused on addressing impactful problems that have practical and societal relevance. WSAI s interdisciplinary structure is particularly important for researchers working in modern AI and Data Science because many emerging research challenges cannot be addressed effectively through a single academic discipline. The School s research environment provides fellows with opportunities to: Work with faculty members specializing in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. Develop research projects and independent research directions. Collaborate across disciplines. Interact with researchers and scientists from around the world. Access advanced computing infrastructure. Participate in workshops and academic colloquia. Develop publication records through high-quality research. Mentor students and contribute to the academic community. Build connections with researchers in academia and industry. For candidates interested in building a research-oriented career in AI or Data Science, the WSAI fellowships can provide an environment for developing both technical expertise and research independence. WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship 2026 The WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship is designed for outstanding researchers who have already completed a PhD and want to continue developing their research careers in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related application areas. The programme is particularly suited to candidates who have demonstrated strong academic or research capabilities and are interested in developing independent research lines under supportive mentorship. According to WSAI, the fellowship environment is designed to nurture scientific leadership . Fellows are encouraged to move beyond simply contributing to existing projects and instead develop their own research directions with guidance and support from experienced faculty. Who Is the Postdoctoral Fellowship For? The Post Doctoral Fellowship is intended for: Outstanding candidates who hold a PhD degree . Researchers whose doctoral research is related to Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or allied application domains . Researchers interested in developing independent research programmes. Candidates seeking mentorship from leading faculty in Data Science and AI. Researchers who want access to advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. Individuals interested in publishing research and participating in an interdisciplinary academic environment. A PhD in a relevant field is therefore the central academic requirement described for this fellowship. Benefits of the WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship The WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship provides several benefits designed to support both the professional development and research activities of fellows. 1. Monthly Fellowship Stipend of INR 1 Lakh The fellowship includes a monthly stipend of INR 1 lakh . This financial support is intended to provide fellows with funding while they undertake their research at WSAI. 2. Interdisciplinary Research Environment Fellows become part of a highly interdisciplinary environment where researchers working in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence can interact and collaborate. This can expose researchers to different methodologies, perspectives, technical approaches, and application areas. 3. Mentorship by Leading Faculty Postdoctoral fellows receive the opportunity to work with and receive mentorship from leading faculty members in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. Mentorship can be particularly valuable for researchers seeking to establish independent research programmes and develop their scientific leadership. 4. Opportunity to Mentor Students The fellowship also provides fellows with opportunities to mentor bright students . This can allow postdoctoral researchers to gain additional academic experience while contributing to the development of the next generation of researchers. 5. Research and Travel Allowances In addition to the monthly stipend, the fellowship includes additional allowances for research and travel . Such support can help fellows participate in research-related activities and academic events. 6. Workshops and International Colloquia WSAI regularly organizes workshops and colloquia involving international experts . Fellows can benefit from exposure to current research developments and opportunities to interact with experts working in different areas of AI and Data Science. 7. High-Performance Computing Infrastructure Researchers receive access to state-of-the-art high-performance computing infrastructure . This is particularly significant for researchers working with computationally intensive AI and Data Science projects that require substantial CPU or GPU resources. WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship Program 2026 The WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship Program is designed for exceptional graduates and postgraduates seeking an extended research experience in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. The programme can provide an opportunity to spend up to two years undertaking research in an advanced academic environment. Unlike a conventional short-term internship, the fellowship is structured around deeper research engagement. Participants can work on research problems, interact with scientists, develop technical skills, contribute to publications, and potentially earn academic course credits at IIT Madras. Who Can Apply for the WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship? The stated eligibility requirements are: Applicants should have a four-year Bachelor s degree or a Master s degree . The degree should be in an area relevant to WSAI . Applicants should be under 27 years of age . The programme is therefore particularly suitable for young graduates and postgraduate students who want to explore research in AI and Data Science before pursuing a longer-term academic or research career. Applicants should ensure that their academic background is relevant to the research areas of WSAI. Benefits of the WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship The programme provides a range of academic, research, professional, and networking opportunities. Work at a Leading Research Centre Fellows have the opportunity to work at one of India s leading research centres for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence . This provides exposure to a research-focused environment and the opportunity to work alongside experienced academics and researchers. Interact With Scientists From Around the World The fellowship allows participants to interact with top scientists from around the world . International academic exposure can help fellows develop professional networks and gain insight into current developments in AI and Data Science. Access to High-Performance Computing Participants can access state-of-the-art CPU and GPU high-performance computing infrastructure . This can be particularly valuable for computational research, machine learning, deep learning, large-scale data analysis, and other areas requiring significant computing resources. Possibility of Earning IIT Madras Course Credits The programme offers the possibility of earning course credits at IIT Madras . This can add an academic component to the research experience and potentially support the fellow s future educational plans. Opportunities to Publish Research Fellows can work toward publishing their research in top journals and A conferences *. Developing a strong publication record can be highly valuable for candidates considering PhD programmes, academic careers, research positions, or advanced technical roles. Support for Top-Tier Publications According to WSAI, any publication in a top-tier venue will be supported by the Centre s infrastructure. This demonstrates the programme s emphasis on producing high-quality research rather than simply completing short-term projects. Fully Funded National Conference Trip Fellows receive a fully funded trip to a national conference every year . Conference participation can provide opportunities to present research, learn from other researchers, receive feedback, and build professional connections. Previous Fellow Experience WSAI highlights the experience of previous fellows to demonstrate the potential impact of the Post Bacc programme. One former fellow, Siddharth C , described the fellowship as providing guidance, time to learn, access to experts from around the world, and an opportunity to discover his strengths. His experience illustrates how a research fellowship can potentially provide more than technical training. It can also help participants clarify their academic interests, identify areas of specialization, and prepare for further studies. According to the testimonial provided by WSAI, the fellowship experience contributed to Siddharth s subsequent journey toward a Master s in Computing Science at the University of Alberta . WSAI Post Bacc-W Fellowship Program 2026 The WSAI Post Bacc-W Fellowship Program is a dedicated two-year research fellowship exclusively for women . The programme seeks exceptional graduates and postgraduates who want to undertake research in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence while receiving mentorship and access to advanced research infrastructure. The programme is designed to support women interested in building research careers in AI and Data Science and provides opportunities for academic development, research publication, professional networking, and participation in major computing-related events. Eligibility Requirements for the Women Post Bacc Fellowship The eligibility requirements provided by WSAI include: Applicants must have a four-year Bachelor s degree or a Master s degree . The degree should be in an area relevant to WSAI . Applicants under 28 years of age are encouraged to apply . The programme is exclusively for women . Candidates should ensure that their academic background aligns with the research areas available through WSAI. Benefits of the WSAI Women Post Bacc Fellowship The programme provides several benefits aimed at helping women develop as researchers and technology professionals. Research at WSAI Participants can work at a leading research centre focused on Data Science and Artificial Intelligence . The research environment can provide exposure to advanced AI methodologies and interdisciplinary research. Interaction With International Scientists Fellows have opportunities to interact with top scientists from around the world . International engagement can broaden participants understanding of the global AI research ecosystem. Publication Opportunities Fellows can work toward publishing research in top journals and A conferences *. The Centre also states that publications in top-tier venues will receive support from its infrastructure. Mentorship by Women Experts A particularly important feature of the programme is mentorship by women experts from academia or industry . This provides fellows with opportunities to learn from experienced women working in research and professional environments. Access to CPU and GPU Computing Participants receive access to state-of-the-art CPU and GPU infrastructure . Such computing resources can be important for research involving machine learning, artificial intelligence, data-intensive applications, and computational experimentation. Potential IIT Madras Course Credits Participants have the possibility of earning course credits at IIT Madras , providing an additional academic dimension to the fellowship. Fully Funded Annual Conference Trip The fellowship includes a fully funded trip to a national conference every year . This can help fellows present their work, meet researchers, discover new research opportunities, and expand their professional networks. Participation in Major Women-in-Computing Events Participants may also attend major events and initiatives such as: ACM-W Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing These opportunities can provide additional networking, professional development, and exposure to the wider technology community. Previous Women Post Bacc Fellow Experience WSAI also shares a testimonial from Abjasree S, Data Scientist at Datycs , who described the fellowship as personally and professionally enriching. Her testimonial emphasizes several aspects of the fellowship experience, including the freedom to choose research problems, collaboration with experienced academics, expert guidance, interaction with exceptional peers, and development of technical skills. The experience also highlights the importance of multidisciplinary teamwork and the opportunity to pursue research that can contribute meaningfully to society. Comparing the Three WSAI Fellowship Opportunities The three fellowship programmes serve different categories of applicants. Fellowship Main Target Group Academic Requirement Age Requirement Duration/Structure WSAI Post Doctoral Fellowship Experienced researchers PhD in Data Science, AI, or allied application domains Not specified in provided information Postdoctoral research WSAI Post Bacc Fellowship Exceptional graduates and postgraduates Four-year Bachelor s or Master s degree relevant to WSAI Under 27 Up to two years WSAI Post Bacc-W Fellowship Women graduates and postgraduates Four-year Bachelor s or Master s degree relevant to WSAI Under 28 encouraged Two years Applicants should carefully select the programme corresponding to their educational background, career stage, and eligibility. Why Consider the WSAI Fellowships? There are several reasons why these fellowships may be attractive to candidates interested in AI and Data Science. 1. Strong Research Focus The programmes are designed around research rather than only classroom learning. This makes them particularly relevant to candidates considering careers in academia, research institutions, technology, or advanced AI development. 2. Access to Advanced Infrastructure AI research can require substantial computing resources. Access to state-of-the-art CPU and GPU infrastructure can enable fellows to undertake computational projects that may otherwise be difficult to conduct independently. 3. Faculty Mentorship Mentorship from experienced researchers can help fellows refine research questions, improve methodologies, interpret results, develop publications, and establish stronger academic directions. 4. International Exposure Interactions with international experts can expose fellows to global research trends and provide opportunities to develop professional connections beyond their immediate academic environment. 5. Publication Opportunities For candidates planning an academic or research career, publications can be an important part of their professional profile. WSAI specifically highlights opportunities to publish in top journals and A* conferences. 6. Conference Participation The funded national conference trip provides fellows with opportunities to engage with the wider research community. 7. Research Independence The WSAI environment encourages fellows to develop independent research lines. title: DT Global P4SP Program Officer Job 2027–2029: Remote International Development Opportunity in Australia and Fiji
summary: Are you an experienced professional looking for an opportunity to contribute to international development, social protection, program management, research, learning and regional engagement across the Pacific? The Partnerships for Social Protection (P4SP) program, implemented by DT Global Asia Pacific and commissioned by the Australian Government through the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT), is seeking a qualified Program Officer to support the implementation of major regional activities. This is a full-time position offering an opportunity to work within a major Australian Government-supported international development program focused on strengthening social protection systems across Pacific nations. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting regional program implementation, learning activities, research, communications, monitoring, evaluation, reporting, logistics and stakeholder engagement. The position is particularly suitable for professionals who have experience in international development, project or program management, communications, social policy, research, training or related disciplines. The contract is expected to run from January 2027 until September 2029 , providing the successful candidate with a long-term opportunity to contribute to a significant regional development initiative. Importantly, this is a remote home-based role , although the successful candidate may occasionally be required to attend DT Global office locations and participate in domestic and international travel within Australia and the Pacific region. Applications officially close at 5:00 PM AEST on 21 September 2026 . Overview of the DT Global P4SP Program Officer Position The Program Officer will support the implementation and coordination of regional activities under the Partnerships for Social Protection program. The role involves working closely with the Deputy Team Leader , the Communications and Public Diplomacy Manager , activity leads, consultants, government partners and other members of the P4SP and DT Global teams. A major component of the position involves supporting learning and knowledge-sharing activities. This includes helping to develop, coordinate and deliver: Online learning sessions; In-person training activities; E-learning materials; Internal learning events; Brown bag lunches; Workshops and planning activities; Research initiatives; Regional engagement activities; and Other knowledge-sharing opportunities. The Program Officer will also contribute to program management processes, monitoring and evaluation activities, planning, reporting, communications, procurement support and event coordination. This makes the position highly multidisciplinary and particularly valuable for professionals seeking to build or expand their careers in international development and Pacific regional programming. Key Job Details Position Program Officer Employment Type Full-time Contract Period January 2027 to September 2029 Work Arrangement Remote/home-based Possible Locations Fiji, Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne or Adelaide Travel Domestic and international travel may be required Reporting To Deputy Team Leader Application Deadline 21 September 2026, 5:00 PM AEST Program Partnerships for Social Protection (P4SP) Implementing Organisation DT Global Asia Pacific About DT Global Asia Pacific DT Global Asia Pacific is an international development organisation that works across Asia and the Pacific to support governments, communities and stakeholders in addressing complex development challenges. The organisation focuses on developing locally led and sustainable solutions that contribute to improved social, economic and environmental outcomes. With more than 1,500 staff and experts working across more than 22 countries, DT Global brings together technical expertise and regional experience to deliver initiatives across a broad range of sectors. Its work includes areas such as: Inclusive economic growth; Essential public services; Governance; Justice systems; Climate resilience; Infrastructure development; Social equity; Community resilience; Security; and Sustainable development. DT Global has more than six decades of development experience and works in partnership with governments, communities, institutions and other stakeholders to address national and transnational development challenges. The organisation places significant emphasis on collaboration, innovation and long-term impact. The Program Officer joining P4SP will therefore become part of a wider network of development professionals working on initiatives across Asia and the Pacific. About the Partnerships for Social Protection (P4SP) Program The Partnerships for Social Protection program, commonly known as P4SP , is an Australian Government-supported international development initiative focused on strengthening social protection systems across Pacific nations. The program was commissioned by the Australian Government through the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and is implemented by DT Global. P4SP is an eight-year program with a total value of AUD 36 million . The initiative supports governments across Pacific countries to strengthen their national social protection systems and improve the ability of social protection policies and programs to reach people who need support. The program commenced on 20 September 2021 and will operate until 19 September 2029 . P4SP works through both bilateral and regional activities. Its work focuses on helping government partners improve the: Quality of social protection systems; Inclusiveness of social protection programs; Sustainability of national systems; Coverage of vulnerable populations; Delivery of social protection policies; Awareness of social protection; Demand for inclusive and effective services; and Capacity of governments and institutions working in the sector. A key outcome of the program is to support governments in increasingly addressing gaps and bottlenecks affecting the coverage and inclusiveness of social protection policies and program delivery. The program operates within a highly adaptive and demand-driven environment. This means that activities are influenced by the priorities and needs of partner governments and Australian Government representatives in participating countries. As a result, professionals working with P4SP have an opportunity to engage with a dynamic regional development environment and contribute to initiatives that respond to evolving needs across Pacific communities. What Is the Purpose of the Program Officer Role? The central purpose of the Program Officer position is to support the implementation of P4SP regional activities. The successful candidate will contribute to activities related to: Learning; Research; Stakeholder engagement; Program coordination; Communications; Monitoring and evaluation; Reporting; Event management; and Knowledge sharing. The role provides an opportunity for the successful candidate to gain deeper knowledge and practical experience in the area of social protection. Social protection is becoming increasingly important within international development because governments and development partners are seeking stronger systems that can protect vulnerable populations, respond to economic and social shocks and improve inclusion. Through involvement in the regional portfolio, the Program Officer will gain exposure to development programming across the Pacific while supporting initiatives designed to improve government capacity and social protection outcomes. Major Responsibilities of the Program Officer The Program Officer will have a broad range of responsibilities covering program management, coordination, learning, research, communications and administration. 1. Supporting Program Management A major responsibility of the successful candidate will be supporting the efficient management of P4SP regional activities. This includes supporting activities connected to: Learning; Research; Communications; Events; Monitoring; Evaluation; Research; Learning and adaptation. The Program Officer will assist activity leads and other team members in ensuring that program components are effectively coordinated and implemented. This may involve monitoring activity progress, maintaining planning tools, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that important information is accurately documented. 2. Coordinating Program Activities The successful candidate will support the coordination and implementation of key regional activities and program components. Working under the guidance of relevant activity leads, the Program Officer may help ensure that activities move efficiently from planning to implementation. This requires strong organisational abilities and the capacity to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to coordination processes while ensuring that deadlines, responsibilities and deliverables are appropriately tracked. 3. Supporting E-Learning Development One of the particularly important areas of responsibility involves supporting the development of e-learning materials. The Program Officer will work with: Consultants; Technical specialists; P4SP team members; and Other relevant stakeholders. The successful candidate may assist in coordinating the development of digital learning resources designed to support knowledge sharing and capacity development. This responsibility makes the position particularly relevant for applicants with experience in: Digital learning; Training coordination; Educational content development; Communications; Digital content management; and Online program delivery. 4. Supporting Learning and Training Activities The position has a significant learning and capacity-building component. The Program Officer will support the coordination and delivery of learning activities, including both virtual and physical sessions. Potential activities may include: Online training sessions; In-person workshops; Learning events; Internal knowledge-sharing sessions; Brown bag lunches; Professional development activities; and Other regional learning initiatives. Applicants with previous experience coordinating workshops, training programs, webinars or knowledge-sharing events may therefore have an advantage. 5. Maintaining Program Management Tools and Trackers Effective program management requires accurate and up-to-date information. The Program Officer will support the maintenance of important program management tools and trackers. These may include: Activity trackers; Tasking notes; Contract trackers; Planning tools; Budget monitoring tools; and Other program management records. Attention to detail will therefore be essential. The successful candidate must be able to manage information accurately and ensure that key documents remain current. 6. This aspect of the role requires excellent written communication and strong administrative skills. Applicants should be comfortable communicating professionally with a wide range of stakeholders. 7.
